reference: Anchored rescue; adaptive follow-up to the fixed stoppage-context screen
hypothesis: Weak-supervised stoppage heads find high-confidence cores but truncate true stoppages. Hysteresis can extend only validated cores through nearby lower-confidence stationary evidence, improving intervals without global D-confidence changes.
data: Reuse training-only OOF head probabilities from context_weak/context_restart_weak; no new fit or held-out targets enter inference. Same frozen public folds and exclusions. No video or private labels.

screen.rule: 51-frame-smoothed D head>.8 for at least50 consecutive frames, centered51-frame visibility>=.5, moving-contact evidence<=.2. Extend each qualifying core by at most125frames in either direction, stopping at head<low threshold, visibility<.5, or moving-contact evidence>.2. Raise D to head probability inside core+extension, retain anchored ownership and all other emissions. Every core and extension is observation/model derived.

confirmation: Freeze up to2 unchanged settings for all three seeds/protocols. Apply the original substantial-gain and secondary-regression rules in RENEWAL_RESEARCH_PLAN. Do not treat further seed checks as independent evidence.
